text:
Leah P: quick capture from the regional failover follow-up meeting. consolidating action items so owners can pick up. keeping this thread as the single source for weekly closure notes.

Marco H: summary: during the rehearsal, partial control-plane slowness caused the router to prefer origin instead of warm-standby; healthchecks were noisy.

Ivy (SRE): we also hit a restore hang because some snapshots lacked the cross-region tag. runbook assumed replication and continued, causing a 25m delay.

ops-bot: incident linked: INC-2024-4712 (regional-failover-rehearsal) https://incidents.redwood.dev/INC-2024-4712

Ravi (Oncall): I'll own tracking. please ack items and add PR/board links. I'll run weekly gating until everything is closed.

Leah P: ACTION-1: router fallback rule: if control-plane API p95 > 750ms for 3m, route by per-az socket-health metric to warm-standby. Owner: Marco H. Due: 2024-05-20. Deliverables: PR + routing-sim integration test.

Marco H: ack. adding unit tests and a canary plan. aiming for a 2024-05-22 canary window.

Leah P: ACTION-2: runbook restore preflight: add explicit check for snapshot replication tag + checksum verification; define abort vs retry behavior. Owner: Ivy (SRE). Due: 2024-04-30.

Ivy (SRE): ack. will add a script snippet and failure semantics. snippet to include: ```bash
aws ec2 describe-snapshots --filters Name=tag:service,Values=redwood Name=tag:replicated,Values=true
```

Leah P: ACTION-3: backup policy audit across all regions, create CSV with service, region, retention-days, last-success, replicated-yes/no. Standardize critical state to 90d. Owner: Ivy (SRE) + infra. Due: 2024-05-04.

Ivy (SRE): starting scan today, will push CSV to DR project board.

Leah P: ACTION-4: priming/kv-cache job must error loudly on auth failures and push items to a short retry queue. add prometheus alert priming_job_auth_failures > 0 for 10m. Owner: Marco H. Due: 2024-04-28.

Marco H: working on auth-check patch now, will open PR and alert rule.

Ravi (Oncall): ACTION-5: create DR game-day checklist (30m tabletop + 2h rehearsal playbook) with owner rotation and contact flow. Owner: Ravi. Due: 2024-05-08. I'll post calendar invites when ready.

Leah P: ACTION-6: add a short runbook section for k8s leader-flip heuristics and how router should behave during leader election thrash. Owner: Marco H. Due: 2024-05-01.

Marco H: noted. will include guidance and a mitigation flag that keeps routing stable for 60s after a leader flip.

Ivy (SRE): ACTION-7: add daily credential-expiry check in CI for priming job credentials so rotation windows are visible. Owner: Ivy. Due: 2024-05-06.

Ravi (Oncall): please add all ACTIONs as tickets on the DR board; tag me for weekly reminders. I'll close the thread after confirming first weekly check.

ops-bot: deploy: routing-sim v0.5 promoted to staging at 2024-04-21T12:00:00Z

Leah P: small coordination note: keep PRs small (<200 LOC) and include a one-line test plan to speed review. if any ETA slips > 3 days, flag here so we can re-scope.

Marco H: PR WIP: https://git.redwood.dev/r/501/router-fallback, will add tests.

Ivy (SRE): PR WIP: https://git.redwood.dev/r/509/backup-audit, https://git.redwood.dev/r/512/runbook-restore-checks

Ravi (Oncall): scheduled weekly reminders starting 2024-04-24. will post DR board links shortly.

Leah P: thanks everyone. closing for now; Ravi will post progress updates weekly. :spiral_calendar:
